say:0:1660215001:2.text: You arrive at the old manor. The garden has withered from neglect, casting a bleak, abandoned look over the entire place.
say:0:1660215001:2.source_cn: 你们来到了罗万曾经居住的庄园，花园中的草木由于缺少打理...
say:0:1660215001:2.male: You arrive at the old manor. The garden has withered from neglect, casting a bleak, abandoned look over the entire place.
say:0:1660215001:2.female: You arrive at the old manor. The garden has withered from neglect, casting a bleak, abandoned look over the entire place.

say:1:1660215002:0.text: Rowan doesn't head for the manor. Instead, he winds through the garden until he stops beside a pond.
say:1:1660215002:0.source_cn: 罗万却没有向城堡里走，他在花园里七拐八绕，来到一个水池旁边。

say:3:1660215003:0.source_cn: 布拉达克一世！你在哪里？！

say:7:1660215005:0.text: Young master... you came all this way for that... duck? Doesn't look like it's made of gold to me.
say:7:1660215005:0.source_cn: 少爷啊，你千里迢迢赶回这里，就为了这只……鸭子？它看着...

say:8:1660215006:0.text: That's not just any duck. That's my dearest friend!

say:10:1660215007:0.text: They used to say Bradduck brought good fortune. I denied it. No one believed me.
say:10:1660215007:0.source_cn: 过去，有人说布拉达克一世能带来财运，我否认了，可没人相信。

say:11:1660215008:0.text: Now I say I've got nothing, and still, no one believes me.
say:11:1660215008:0.source_cn: 现在，我说我一无所有，还是没人相信。

say:12:1660215009:0.text: But I will reclaim it all—the house, the guild, the life I lost... one piece at a time. Starting with Bradduck!
say:12:1660215009:0.source_cn: 庄园、古董、商会……总有一天，我会像接回布拉达克一世一...

say:13:1660215010:0.text: Rowan looks at each of you, watching your reactions carefully, as though he's bracing for someone to laugh.
say:13:1660215010:0.source_cn: 罗万一边说，一边打量着你们的神情，好像生怕你们不信一样。
say:13:1660215010:0.male: Rowan looks at each of you, watching your reactions carefully, as though he's bracing for someone to laugh.
say:13:1660215010:0.female: Rowan looks at each of you, watching your reactions carefully, as though he's bracing for someone to laugh.

say:16:1660215012:3.text: Suddenly, the dream reacts. Branches twist unnaturally. Vines slither across the ground, coiling toward your feet like they want to pull you under!
say:16:1660215012:3.source_cn: 你道破梦境核心的瞬间，周边的藤蔓和树枝盘旋卷曲，如同蛇...
say:16:1660215012:3.male: Suddenly, the dream reacts. Branches twist unnaturally. Vines slither across the ground, coiling toward your feet like they want to pull you under!
say:16:1660215012:3.female: Suddenly, the dream reacts. Branches twist unnaturally. Vines slither across the ground, coiling toward your feet like they want to pull you under!

say:17:1660215013:2.text: You raise your voice and sing the Song of Summer. Soren grabs Rowan and takes off running. In the distance, the illusion of Odie lowers himself onto the fountain's edge and gives you a wave.
say:17:1660215013:2.source_cn: 你高声唱响《夏日之歌》，索恩则带着罗万向前奔跑，阿德的...
say:17:1660215013:2.male: You raise your voice and sing the Song of Summer. Soren grabs Rowan and takes off running. In the distance, the illusion of Odie lowers himself onto the fountain's edge and gives you a wave.

say:18:1660215014:3.source_cn: 《夏日之歌》的旋律编织成一张网，倏忽间，黑暗再次来临，...

choice_prompt:19:1660215014.text: The song unfurls into a woven net of melody, and in a heartbeat, darkness returns. Floating within it is a single shining speck, like an autumn ginkgo leaf caught in the air.
choice_prompt:19:1660215014.source_cn: 《夏日之歌》的旋律编织成一张网，倏忽间，黑暗再次来临，其中有一枚光点闪耀，像一叶秋日的银杏。

choice:15:1:2.text: This is just a dream. You're going to wake up.
choice:15:1:2.male: This is just a dream. You're going to wake up.
